entities.name: Ethical Policy and Nationalist Awakening
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Ethical Policy and Nationalist Awakening, a transformative movement in Indonesia (1870–1942). Emerged from Cultivation System forces Javanese peasants into compulsory crop production and Java War — Prince Diponegoro's rebellion against Dutch rule. Catalyzed Sukarno founds the PNI (Indonesian National Party) to demand independence and Japanese forces conquer the entire Dutch East Indies within three months.
